judgement.reason: HedgeDoc 2 is a separate backend server and frontend server built from different images that must run together behind a proxy, and Deployz runs only one web service.

evidence.quote: HedgeDoc 2 will be split in two components. The backend and the frontend. Both are present in this repository.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker/docker-compose.yml defines 2 application services (backend, frontend). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The compose file runs a separate frontend image beside the backend, and HedgeDoc 2 needs both, so no shown line proves the frontend service is optional for production.
